result.message: Google Patents search needs a free SerpApi key (250 searches a month). Sign up at https://serpapi.com/users/sign_up, copy the key from https://serpapi.com/manage-api-key, then save it by running this in a terminal: /Users/serkankose/patent-creator-venv/bin/patent-creator config set SERPAPI_API_KEY "YOUR_KEY" and restart Claude Code. (This is Step 3 of the README's Quick Start.)
result.fallback: search_patents_bigquery, once the optional BigQuery setup is done (a Google Cloud project; see 'Setting up BigQuery' in the README). The free SerpApi key is the quicker route. Until a key is set, a web first screen is possible: WebSearch restricted to patents.google.com, then WebFetch the closest patent pages. Label it a first screen; an empty or thin result is not evidence of no prior art. Give the user the setup steps from `message` in plain words, including the links, so they can turn on full patent search.
